event.text:
A fence whose last line is blank:

```go
func first() {}

```

It keeps that blank while more arrives after it.

The same fence twice in a row:

```go
func twice() {}
```

```go
func twice() {}
```

Both are highlighted alike, and so is this one while the paragraph after it grows:

```bash
echo "still highlighted"
```

A paragraph that keeps growing after the fence, word by word, until it wraps across more than one row of the terminal.

An indented line that would read as a link definition without its indent:

    [note]:
https://example.com/note

And the answer carries on after it.
